<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- status bar -->

    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="327" y1="17" x2="327" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="337" y="12" width="4" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <rect x="349" y="8" width="4" height="11" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <rect x="372" y="9" width="16" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="374" y="11" width="11" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="388" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- top conversation bar -->

    <rect x="0" y="27" width="390" height="61" fill="#060606"/>

    <text x="84" y="75" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF80">Active now</text>
    <circle cx="300" cy="58" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>

  <!-- conversation -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF59">Today 9:34 AM</text>
    <circle cx="26" cy="139" r="15" fill="#455154"/>
    <text x="26" y="144" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">AM</text>

      <rect x="47" y="120" width="187" height="42" rx="20" fill="#434343"/>
      <text x="64" y="138" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">Hey! Are we still on for</text>
      <text x="64" y="156" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">tonight?</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="133" y="171" width="221" height="42" rx="20" fill="#0584FE"/>
      <text x="151" y="189" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">Absolutely. I found a great</text>
      <text x="151" y="207" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">place downtown.</text>
    </g>
    <text x="352" y="227" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF80">Read 9:36 AM</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="47" y="235" width="198" height="42" rx="20" fill="#434343"/>
      <text x="64" y="253" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">Nice! Send me the details</text>
      <text x="64" y="271" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">when you can.</text>
    </g>

      <rect x="195" y="286" width="159" height="41" rx="20" fill="#0584FE"/>

    </g>
    <text x="352" y="341" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF80">Delivered</text>

    <text x="352" y="477" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF80">Seen 9:38 AM</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="47" y="487" width="212" height="41" rx="20" fill="#434343"/>
      <text x="65" y="513" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">Looks perfect, thank you!</text>
